**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/27 (Sat) 12:11
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The system allows for multiple users to be created, with different roles including Admin, Tagger, and Checker.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Admins have full control over the system, while Tagers and Checkers have specific permissions to tag and verify annotations respectively.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Admins can create tasks, assign them to specific users, set due dates, and view the progress of the task.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The task management screen shows a list of all documents assigned to the task, and information about who is the Tagger, Checker, assigned date, due date, and description.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The system includes a tool for Tagers to annotate documents, allowing them to view the document and add annotations using different labels and classifications.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Data Scientists can access annotated data through an API, which provides access to a dataset of completed documents and detailed information about the data.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Common error messages include "Data not found" and "Data already downloaded".
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Users can contact support through the help page for assistance.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested flows for actions for each role include creating a dataset, task management, changing task status, and assigning users.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested video topics include creating a task, annotating documents, verifying annotations, and changing document status.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Emphasized the importance of accurately annotating and verifying the annotations.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided tips for efficiently using the product and mentioned any limitations or restrictions of the product.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Encouraged users to provide feedback for future improvements.

- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Detailed the steps for Tagers to view tasks, annotate documents, and change document status.
